header.running_head: The Justice of Hadhrat Umar Farooq (RA)

blocks.text: people used to frequently visit her. When she was summoned, it was said to her, "Respond to the call of Umar." She bemoaned, "Alas! I am destroyed! What does Umar want with me?!" (She was pregnant and) As she was still on her way, she became so frightened that labour pains struck. She entered a house where the child was born. However, the child screamed only twice and then it died.
